root_cause: The 08:00 Europe/Amsterdam publication was missed. The first recovery fix increased the Netlify cadence to ten minutes, but it invoked only powerhouse-social-publisher. That publisher can dispatch only existing content_ready decisions with artifacts; it cannot regenerate a missing daily decision/artifact. Therefore a generation/orchestration miss could remain visibly absent even while the recovery schedule itself was healthy.
prevention_rule: Keep exactly one canonical content owner. Every bounded social recovery invocation must enter through powerhouse-content-loop so it can perform generation/orchestration, channel gates, canonical provider dispatch and reconciliation before fresh delivery readback. Never create a parallel provider writer or bypass daily uniqueness, capability consumption, exact-content identity or provider readback gates.
